intro:
RMC Pharmacy at Plaza Gali is a pharmacy and minimarket on Blvd. Paseo de la Marina, in the Centro and Marina area of Cabo San Lucas. You will find us at Loc 47, open every day from 9 am to 6 pm. Our team speaks English and Spanish, so you can ask for what you need in the language you prefer.

Come in for everyday essentials such as sun care, first aid, hydration and personal care, or message us on WhatsApp at +52 624 226 1023 to check what we have before you walk over.

If you would rather stay where you are, we deliver to hotels and villas in Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo, with estimated delivery of up to 70 minutes. You place the order in a WhatsApp chat and pay by card through a secure link.

This store also connects you with our services: IV therapy at your villa or hotel, doctor consultations by video, and home nursing with our sister brand Cabo Nurse.

faq.q: Do you deliver to hotels?
faq.a: Yes, to hotels and villas in Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo. Estimated delivery up to 70 minutes.

faq.q: Can you deliver to the hotel lobby?
faq.a: Yes, we deliver to the lobby of your hotel. Send us the hotel name on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you speak English?
faq.a: Yes, English and Spanish.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment?
faq.a: No, you can walk in. We attend without an appointment.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept in the store?
faq.a: Cash or card, in Mexican pesos or US dollars.

faq.q: How do I pay for a delivery?
faq.a: You pay by card through a secure payment link in the WhatsApp chat where you place your order.
